propositions: LLM token usage fields computed by the runner (_extract_usage) and attached as result[_usage] are currently discarded by the review path, leaving no retrievable record of token consumption.

finalize._attach_code_review_metrics must aggregate input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, and total_tokens across all succeeded agent steps (Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide) that expose _usage, adding these to coverage.metrics.

voter must implement best-effort boto3 emission of five CloudWatch metrics (review_bot_llm_input/output/cache_read/cache_write/total_tokens) to Namespace rebar/host with Unit Count, plus a greppable LLM_TOKEN_USAGE journald marker after successful vote, swallowing all boto3 import/credential/network errors.

Pass-1 finder-step token usage is excluded from this scope because production_batch_runner does not surface per-finder _usage on its output; a follow-up ticket will capture finder usage through the plan-review path.

The token publisher is invoked after a successful vote, reading totals from decision[verdict][coverage][metrics], ensuring the vote is cast before any best-effort metric emission (metric failure cannot affect voting outcome).
